about: Producer: notes/halo_kernel_model/plots/make_figure_data.py from analysis/halo_kernel/model/hk_model.json and hk_model.build (kernels_<sn>.npz, weighted_<sn>.npz, stoch_<sn>.npz). Top: kappa_r/kappa_d, the object-level regression kernel over the large-scale kernel, weighted by the number of centrals (c) or satellites (s) per host-mass bin, per snapshot z. Bottom: the 2-halo galaxy II (measured P_EE minus the measured 1-halo term) over three 2-halo predictions on the mean-HOD fields: det = deterministic II only, det_res = deterministic + residual II (the residual halo-shape II with kappa_r), full_ls = the full halo-shape II with the large-scale kernels; z = 1 and 2, k in h/Mpc. neg_ii_max, neg_bb_max: the largest negative value of the residual II and of the 2-halo BB at 0.1 <= k <= 1.3 over all snapshots, in units of the model total P_EE, P_BB.
